steps.title: Task specific pretrained weight fine tuning

blocks.text: Keep the pretrained baseline mapping separate from the new task head mapping.

For the bounded ViT image-classification adaptation, import torch, nn from torch, and AutoImageProcessor, ViTForImageClassification, TrainingArguments and Trainer from transformers. Load the supplied compatible checkpoint with ViTForImageClassification.from_pretrained(checkpoint). Retain its original label mapping for the pretrained baseline before replacing the task head. Load the matching processor with AutoImageProcessor.from_pretrained(checkpoint). Calling that processor on images with return_tensors="pt" produces pixel_values; passing the resulting inputs as keyword arguments to the model yields logits through its .logits attribute. Use this same checkpoint processor for training and validation images rather than an unrelated representation.

With the supplied preprocessed datasets and image collator, construct TrainingArguments with the declared output_dir, num_train_epochs, per_device_train_batch_size and learning_rate. Set eval_strategy="epoch" and remove_unused_columns=False. Construct Trainer with model, args, train_dataset, eval_dataset=validation_dataset, data_collator and processing_class=processor. Its train method executes the bounded supervised adaptation.

left.code:
import torch
from torch import nn
from transformers import AutoImageProcessor, ViTForImageClassification
from transformers import TrainingArguments, Trainer
model = ViTForImageClassification.from_pretrained(checkpoint)
processor = AutoImageProcessor.from_pretrained(checkpoint)
original_id2label = dict(model.config.id2label)
original_label2id = dict(model.config.label2id)
inputs = processor(images, return_tensors="pt")
frozen_baseline_logits = model(**inputs).logits
# Retain baseline outputs on the same validation cohort.

right.code:
for parameter in model.parameters():
    parameter.requires_grad = False
model.classifier = nn.Linear(model.config.hidden_size, num_labels)
model.num_labels = model.config.num_labels = num_labels
model.config.id2label = id2label
model.config.label2id = label2id
args = TrainingArguments(output_dir=output_dir, num_train_epochs=epochs,
    per_device_train_batch_size=batch_size, learning_rate=learning_rate,
    eval_strategy="epoch", remove_unused_columns=False)
trainer = Trainer(model=model, args=args, train_dataset=train_dataset,
    eval_dataset=validation_dataset, data_collator=data_collator,
    processing_class=processor)
trainer.train()
# Verify head changes, frozen backbone, and selected head gradient.
# Compare same-cohort validation under fixed cost/acceptance rules.

blocks.text: For classifier-only adaptation, iterate the existing model parameters and set their requires_grad to False. Then assign a new nn.Linear(model.config.hidden_size, num_labels) to model.classifier. Set model.num_labels and model.config.num_labels to num_labels and set config.id2label and config.label2id to the task maps. The newly constructed head parameters are trainable by default. Verify that head weights change while frozen backbone values do not. Evaluate the fine-tuned task predictions on the same validation cohort as the frozen pretrained output reference, without constructing an application or using protected test data.
For binary validation counts, FPR = FP/(FP+TN) conditions on actual negatives, and FNR = FN/(FN+TP) conditions on actual positives; an empty conditioning group does not yield a defined rate.

blocks.text: Use supplied training and validation images for two task classes. Retain the original pretrained mapping for the frozen baseline, and use the same checkpoint processor for image representation. Freeze existing parameters, replace the classifier with a two-output head using the hidden width, and update num_labels and both label maps. Verify logits shape (N, 2) and long target indices in [0, 2). In the adaptation run, inspect a selected head gradient against the chain-rule reference and verify changed head weights with unchanged frozen-backbone values.
Compare adapted predictions with the frozen supplied reference on the same validation cohort under fixed cost and acceptance rules. Keep protected-test data outside adaptation and selection.
A new head remains trainable by default after freezing old parameters. Verify its target mapping and a matched validation comparison.

public.prompt: Inspect independent excerpts from a bounded two-class ViT supervised adaptation. Judge whether each excerpt supports its stated claim. Supplied training/validation images and scaffold are fixed; protected test observations must not enter adaptation or selection. No execution is requested. The comparison cohort has ten actual negatives and ten actual positives. Fixed deployment probabilities are P(Y=0)=0.5, P(Y=1)=0.5, error costs cost_FP=1, cost_FN=4, and correct predictions cost zero. The acceptance rule declares improvement only when all adaptation checks pass and expected error cost decreases. Sort every excerpt into Supported (all stated contract claims hold) or Defective (at least one stated claim violates the contract). Each excerpt is independent; comments describe recorded fixture evidence.

e1.message: Compatible pretrained representation and mapping are retained; a new trainable two-class head receives the bounded supervised training while frozen backbone values remain unchanged.

e2.message: The task label contract and selected head-gradient reference substantiate the intended supervised signal.

e3.message: Both models use matched validation evidence. The correctly conditioned rates and supplied deployment-cost calculation show a cost decrease; undefined boundary rates are explicitly handled rather than replaced with zero.

e4.message: Classifier-only adaptation requires unchanged frozen backbone values as well as changed head weights.

e5.message: FPR conditions on actual negatives, not predicted positives; an empty actual-positive group makes FNR undefined, not zero.
